featured_items.original_text:
$JD.COM STRENGTHENS ITS PRESENCE IN EUROPE

$JD.com has completed the acquisition of a 59.8% stake in CECONOMY, the parent company of MediaMarkt, Saturn, and MediaWorld, for approximately €1.34 billion.

With this acquisition, https://t.co/TdA7QkKD4E establishes a direct presence in the European market through a network of more than 1,000 stores across 11 countries.

This isn’t just about acquiring retail stores. It’s about combining https://t.co/TdA7QkKD4E’s technology and logistics expertise with an already established retail network.

The goal is to strengthen its international presence and create new growth opportunities.

Of course, the success of this acquisition will depend on the company’s ability to integrate operations, improve margins, and generate an adequate return on invested capital.

For a long-term investor, it will be interesting to follow how this acquisition develops.
featured_items.translation_zh:
$JD.COM 加强其在欧洲的业务布局

$JD.com 已完成收购 CECONOMY 59.8% 的股份，后者是 MediaMarkt、Saturn 和 MediaWorld 的母公司，交易金额约为 €1.34 billion。

通过此次收购，JD.com 通过遍布 11 个国家的 1,000 多家门店网络，在欧洲市场建立了直接业务布局。

这不仅仅是收购零售门店。这是将 JD.com 的技术和物流专长与一个已经建立起来的零售网络相结合。

目标是加强其国际业务布局并创造新的增长机会。

当然，此次收购的成功将取决于该公司整合运营、提高利润率以及产生足够投资资本回报的能力。

对于长期投资者来说，关注此次收购将如何发展会很有意思。
